portInfo.description: Montego Bay is a cruise call—confirm your berth on the daily programme before you plan the day.
portInfo.currency: Jamaican Dollar (JMD), US Dollar widely accepted

climate.description: Tropical climate with warm temperatures year-round

politics.visaRequirements: Visa-free for many nationalities (up to 90 days).
politics.entryRequirements: Valid passport required. Return ticket may be required.

gettingThere.distanceToCity: Beaches and town are marketed as accessible; walk/shuttle minutes from the cruise gate are unverified. Falmouth and Ocho Rios are separate PAJ ports — do not assume a short hop without a timed coach.
gettingThere.publicTransport: Confirm local transport options with the ship on your call date.
gettingThere.distanceAnswer: Beaches and town are marketed as accessible; walk/shuttle minutes from the cruise gate are unverified. Falmouth and Ocho Rios are separate PAJ ports — do not assume a short hop without a timed coach.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Doctor’s Cave and nearby beach areas (confirm access with your ship)
Inland falls or estate tours by coach
Gloucester Avenue (Hip Strip) and downtown markets
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Montego Bay Freeport / SEZ addresses on PAJ contact pages are not automatically the cruise gangway — use Mantica Way cruise contact.
